title: Belief-Sim: Towards Belief-Driven Simulation of Demographic Misinformation Susceptibility

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual demographic substitution (swapping female and male attributes) in prompts to measure prediction flip rates and evaluate whether the model relies on spurious demographic shortcuts (stereotyping) rather than context.

Counterfactual demographic substitution (swapping younger and older age brackets) in prompts to measure prediction flip rates and assess model reliance on age-based stereotypes for misinformation susceptibility.
Counterfactual demographic substitution (swapping educational attainment levels, i.e., completed vs. not completed high school) to measure prediction flip rates and shortcut reliance.

Counterfactual demographic substitution (swapping rural and urban living areas) in prompts to measure prediction flip rates and evaluate spatial/geographic stereotyping in misinformation susceptibility.
